title: We loved our tour with Thais!
text: We recently went on the Montserrat half day Monastery/wine tasting trip with our guide, Thais. What a wonderful experience! Thais was engaging and  incredibly knowledgable about so many aspects of the trip. We enjoyed listening to her stories and facts about Montserrat and about wine and wine-making. It was one of the  best tours on our trip to Spain!
author: timothymG4328YW
